Tap the floor to start the fire.
Tap a wall to mount the alarm and extinguishers.
Move your phone slowly to scan the wall.
Move your phone slowly to scan the floor.
Find and tap the manual call point to raise the alarm.
Scanning the room for a floor.
Tap a wall to mount the extinguishers.
Class A fire, ordinary combustibles. Use the grey extinguisher.
Class B or C fire, liquid or electrical. Use the yellow extinguisher. Never the grey one, it's not safe here.
Multi-class fire. The red, A B C rated extinguisher is safest.
Choose the correct extinguisher for this fire.
Pull the pin.
Aim at the base of the fire.
Press and hold the handle to spray.
Sweep side to side while spraying.
Keep spraying until the fire is out.
Fire out. Nice work!
